commands.name: event_create
commands.description: Makes a new event, timed or all-day.

args.name: title
args.meaning: The event's title; one non-empty line.

args.name: start
args.meaning: Start as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" local time, or "YYYY-MM-DD" with all_day=True.

args.name: end
args.meaning: End as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" local time, or the last day as "YYYY-MM-DD" with all_day=True.

args.name: location
args.meaning: Where it happens.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to put it in, by exact name; None means the first local calendar.

args.name: all_day
args.meaning: True for an all-day event.

args.name: notes
args.meaning: Notes for the event.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: Add a dentist appointment on 18 November from 3:15 to 4 pm in Room 4
Put a team offsite on my Work calendar for 30 November and 1 December
Block out Friday afternoon for the car service
Add Mum's birthday as an all-day event on 5 December
commands.precondition: If calendar is given, exactly one local calendar has that name; if not, at least one local calendar exists. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Calendar.
commands.postcondition: A new event exists with these values. Other events with the same title are left alone.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: title is not one non-empty line, a date is not in the right format, or end is not after start, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": typing into Calendar's date fields through System Events was not reliable

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no local calendar has that exact name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one local calendar has that name; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

args.name: mode

example_requests: What's on my calendar on 18 November?
Show me everything next week

commands.name: event_update
commands.description: Changes the given values of an event and leaves the rest as they are.

args.name: match
args.meaning: The event's exact title now.

args.name: date
args.meaning: The day it starts now, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: title
args.meaning: New title; one non-empty line.

args.name: start
args.meaning: New start, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD" for an all-day event; give end too to move the event.

args.name: end
args.meaning: New end, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", or the last day as "YYYY-MM-DD" for an all-day event.

args.name: location
args.meaning: New location.

args.name: notes
args.meaning: New notes.

args.name: all_day
args.meaning: True or False to change whether it is all-day; None leaves it.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to look in, by exact name, when the same title exists twice that day. It does not move the event.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

Change the Standup on Wednesday to Room 5

commands.postcondition: The event holds the new values, and values not given are unchanged.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no event with that exact title starts that day, within calendar if given, or calendar is given and no local calendar has that name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one event matches; nothing is changed

commands.name: event_details
commands.description: Gets an event with its repeat rule and its alerts.

args.name: match
args.meaning: The event's exact title.

args.name: date
args.meaning: The day it starts, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to look in, by exact name, when the same title exists twice that day.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "background": this command has no verified ui mode.

example_requests: Does the Standup on Monday repeat?
What alerts are set for the Dentist on 18 November?
Show me how often Team sync repeats
commands.precondition: Exactly one event with that title starts that day, within calendar if given. It has Automation permission for Calendar.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no event with that exact title starts that day, within calendar if given

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one event matches; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

repeat is the RRULE text as Calendar stores it, or None; alerts are minutes before the start, leaving out Calendar's own default alert.

commands.name: event_set_repeat
commands.description: Makes an event repeat by an iCalendar RRULE, replacing any repeat it has.

args.name: match
args.meaning: The event's exact title.

args.name: date
args.meaning: The day it starts, "YYYY-MM-DD".

args.name: rule
args.meaning: An RRULE such as "FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=5": FREQ (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY), INTERVAL, COUNT or UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: Local calendar to look in, by exact name, when the same title exists twice that day.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "background": this command has no verified ui mode.

example_requests: Make the Standup repeat every weekday
Repeat the Book club monthly for six months
Set Team sync to every two weeks on Monday and Wednesday
commands.precondition: Exactly one event with that title starts that day, within calendar if given. It has Automation permission for Calendar.
commands.postcondition: The event repeats by the rule; its title and times are unchanged.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no event with that exact title starts that day, within calendar if given

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one event matches; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar's scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui", or rule is None: stopping a repeat isn't supported

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 only, unlike this app's other commands (macOS 26.6.2), so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
Stopping a repeat isn't supported: Calendar's scripting kept the repeat when it was cleared.
Only the first occurrence can be found by match and date, because Calendar's scripting doesn't expand repeats.

commands.name: calendar_export_ics
commands.description: Exports a local calendar to an .ics file (File > Export > Export…).

args.name: name
args.meaning: The local calendar's exact name.

args.name: path
args.meaning: A new .ics path, absolute or starting with ~; its folder must exist.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Calendar's scripting has no export.

example_requests: Export the Family Events calendar to my Desktop
Save the Work calendar as an .ics file
Share my calendar as a file
commands.precondition: The calendar exists. It has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events and Calendar.
commands.postcondition: path holds the calendar's events as iCalendar.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: path doesn't end in .ics, or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no calendar has that name, or path's folder doesn't exist; nothing is done

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.when: something is at path; nothing is overwritten

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the file wasn't written in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: another app came to the front; nothing was exported

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background"

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Calendar 15.0 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
The calendar is chosen by clicking its name in the calendar list, at the centre of that named element's own frame.
Calendar saves the file in the folder its save sheet already shows, under a unique name; the file is then moved to path, so that folder (often Documents) briefly holds it.
On Calendar's first launch its What's New screen gets Continue.
Added on day 4 in its own section and tested on its own.

commands.name: calendar_import_ics
commands.description: Adds the events in an .ics file to a local calendar through Calendar's own Add event window (the calendar chosen by name in its pop-up, then OK).

args.name: path
args.meaning: The .ics file.

args.name: calendar
args.meaning: The local calendar's exact name.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui".

example_requests: Import this .ics file into my Work calendar
Add the events from family_events.ics to Calendar
Load the invite file into the Trips calendar
commands.precondition: The calendar exists. It has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events and Calendar.
commands.postcondition: Every event in the file is in the calendar.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: path doesn't end in .ics, the file has no events, or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no file at path, or no local calendar with that name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: two calendars share the name

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Calendar already shows an Add event window, or a dialog; it was left as it is

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Calendar added none of the events (it skips ones it already has), only some arrived, or a named element never appeared

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background"

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Calendar 15.0 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
The file is opened in Calendar as a double-click would; Calendar skips events it already has without saying so, which is reported as UIError.
Added overnight in its own section and tested on its own.
